presentationNotice: This sample uses representative review data to exercise the renderer. Queued choices validate interaction behavior but do not resolve the repository project model.

currentUnderstanding.body: The renderer only displays the active hash-bound review and collects feedback; it never writes the project model directly. Feedback from this page can still change semantic state after the agent verifies the active review, point, option, and hashes and then invokes the existing semantic review-resolution tool.

delta.possibleMisunderstanding: Browser feedback proposes outcomes; the agent still interprets them before resolution.
consequences: Interrupted polling must leave the active review resumable.
The artifact path must remain stable for the life of the review.

points.title: Adapter boundary
points.context: A separate presentation adapter keeps semantic tools renderer-neutral.
points.question: Where should Lavish presentation live?

options.label: Separate adapter
options.description: Add dag_model_present_review outside the semantic tool set.
options.rationale: Keeps rendering failures outside semantic mutation.

value.title: Use a separate presentation adapter
value.body: Add dag_model_present_review outside the semantic model tools.

options.label: Integrated review tool
options.description: Fold presentation and polling into dag_model_review.
options.rationale: Reduces tool count, but couples browser lifecycle failures to semantic review creation.

points.title: Prototype-only feedback limits example
points.context: This representative second decision proves that one turn can queue multiple independent outcomes. Production still needs feedback bounds because browser annotations can be arbitrarily numerous or large; a cap prevents one poll from exhausting tool or agent context, while explicit truncation reporting prevents silent loss. The numeric choices below are illustrative fixture data, not an active project-model question.
points.question: Which illustrative limit profile should this fixture display?

options.label: Conservative bounds
options.description: Allow 20 prompts, 4 KB per prompt, and 16 KB total per poll result.
options.rationale: Matches the tested prototype defaults and keeps agent context predictable.

options.label: Generous bounds
options.description: Allow 50 prompts, 8 KB per prompt, and 64 KB total per poll result.
options.rationale: Preserves larger annotation batches but can consume substantially more context.
